reason: The report uses a bivariate OLS with no controls, but training hours are strongly related to pre-period firm traits (size, age, prior productivity). When I added the 2020 controls, the coefficient fell from about 2.5 to about 0.58 (SE 0.23), so the reported 2.165 is mostly confounding. The report also never discusses this, and the 1% outcome trimming is unjustified.
